name: Join bar
summary: The dark participant join bar of ahaslides.com (Webflow component Join bar): "Are you a participant?" and an ahaslides.com/ access-code field with a Join button, centred on one line, stacking at 479px and below. Place it directly before the Site navbar (Marketing > Navigation), as a sibling in the same parent, and it scrolls away while the navbar stays stuck to the top, with no positioning script. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Placed directly before the Site navbar it scrolls away while the navigation stays stuck to the top, with no positioning script
Use it on pages a participant may land on looking for a session (the home page and other top-level pages); leave it out where no participant would look for a code
Join is <aha-button size="sm" type="submit"> with no button CSS of its own
Webflow component Join bar (Pattern / Marketing), matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px and 390px
